description: 4-attribute temporal bubble chart visualizing the 'Evaporation Squeeze'.
methodology: Temporal Filtering: Data is restricted to the 1983-2025 'Modern Record' to eliminate manual-measurement artifacts from the mid-20th century. Modeling: As the original SILO rainfall totals were inaccessible in the locked archive, Annual Rainfall (Bubble Size) was estimated using an Inverse Correlation Model derived from the 2004-2019 Caulfield record, ensuring visual continuity for the 4-channel encoding strategy.
citation: Queensland Government (SILO). (2026). SILO (Scientific Information for Land Owners) Database. Rainfall volume estimated via correlation modeling by D. Sharma (2026).
